profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM. The company reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, according to its most recent 10-K filing. Its core business centers on customer relationship management software and related cloud services, and it owns Slack, the workplace messaging platform.

On the AI side, Salesforce offers several tracked products. Slack AI is embedded directly within the Slack messaging platform and the company describes it as providing channel and thread summaries, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, workflow automation, and inline message translation. Slackbot is described as a personal AI agent within Slack that can prepare meeting briefs, analyze reports, and adapt to a user's tone and style. The company states that customer data is not used to train the large language models powering these features, and that those models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Slack also serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, Salesforce's broader CRM-embedded AI and agent platform, allowing Agentforce agents to operate within Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. Tableau AI, branded under the Einstein name, brings natural language querying and AI capabilities to Salesforce's business intelligence product.

The held facts show 174 legal matters with California exposure and the presence of several third-party Model Context Protocol servers built around Salesforce, covering functions such as SOQL querying, Salesforce org administration, and DevOps pipeline management.
